verdict.rationale: Stripe Tax runs some tax work in the background once configured. It calculates tax automatically on payments, including no-code Payment Links. It automates US filing through a TaxJar integration, monitors registration obligations, and can register on your behalf. These are fixed, built-in automations rather than workflows the user designs, and US filing depends on a third-party tool. Community reports show limits: VIES validation runs only once and cannot be retriggered, invoices were left in Draft after enabling automatic tax, and one user said filing and payment were still manual. Missing for 10: user-configurable or agent-driven automation workflows, scheduled or triggered background jobs beyond built-in tax calculation, first-party automated filing outside the US, and independent confirmation that background automation runs reliably.
